why: Puts the floor back on the control's box instead of the part of it a player can press, which is the exact reading that passed the two clipped hull swatches (issue #932). Measured on the tree before #913: both sat at the screen edge of a 320px viewport, reported w=44, cleared the 44px floor, and had 2px of each hanging off the screen with `touch-action: pan-y` preventing any gesture from bringing them back. This mutation restores a check that looks identical and cannot see that.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) fails a control clipped by the screen edge, which measures 44px but cannot all be pressed
